Select molecule_chembl_id aliased as compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles from molecule_dictionary joined with activities on molregno, then with assays on assay_id, then with target_dictionary on tid, and finally with compound_structures on molregno. Filter to target_dictionary.pref_name matching 'adenosine A1 receptor' and assays.assay_organism matching 'Homo sapiens'. Return rows sorted by compound_chembl_id.
